finePrint.summary: Lifetime-deal buyers should expect a per-generation cap even though overall usage is described as unlimited.

quote.text: We do not have any usage limit. However, you cannot have more than 8K characters per voiceover.

finePrint.summary: Paid access is measured in monthly character credits that expire rather than accumulate.

quote.text: We offer subscription plans that provide you with 1 million text characters each month.

finePrint.summary: Paid plans provide monthly credits that reset each cycle and are shared across voice, script, and video uses.

quote.text: Each subscription includes 125,000 monthly credits that reset every billing cycle and can be shared across voice, script, and video workflows.

finePrint.summary: Buyers should assume purchases are final because refunds are generally not offered.

quote.text: Payments already made against one-time plans or subscriptions are not generally eligible for a refund.

finePrint.summary: Buyers should assume purchases are final because the terms state no refund after payment.

quote.text: Payments already made against one-time plan or subscriptions would not be eligible for a refund.

finePrint.summary: The comparable regular subscription cost is $23 monthly, $57 quarterly, or $217 yearly for context on deal value.

quote.text: Here are the subscription plans we offer: Basic Plan - $23/month, Quarterly Saver Plan - $57/quarter, and Mega Saver Plan - $217/year.

finePrint.summary: The vendor can end the agreement or suspend access at any time without notice for a terms violation.

trials.claim: Includes 300+ voices, 129 languages, background music, commercial rights, MP3 and unlimited projects
trials.claimQuote: It includes access to 300+ AI voices in 129 languages and accents, the ability to add background music to voiceovers, commercial usage rights, MP3 downloads, and unlimited projects or campaigns.
trials.reasoning: The binding terms state background music or usage of these files is not part of the pricing, directly conflicting with the claim that background music is included.

exhibits.quote: Background music or usage of these files is not part of the pricing of Speechactors - Trancekode Infoway.
exhibits.argument: The terms exclude background music from pricing, undermining the claim that it is included.

exhibits.argument: Vendor lists 300+ voices, languages, commercial use, MP3 export and background music together.

exhibits.argument: Vendor confirms voices can be used for commercial projects.

trials.claim: Does not offer a voice cloning feature
trials.claimQuote: No, Speechactors does not offer a voice cloning feature.
trials.reasoning: The only exhibit shows an AI voice changer for uploaded audio, which is not evidence of voice cloning and does not prove or disprove that cloning is absent.

exhibits.quote: AI Voice ChangerTransform uploaded audio into a new voice while preserving the original expression, tone, and pitch dynamics.
exhibits.argument: The vendor advertises a voice-changing feature that transforms uploaded audio, undermining the claim of no voice cloning.
